items.item: K3, the condition read in time
items.how: Checked against ConditionInTime.lean. Unrestricted over every step fails wherever there is a formation (not_unrestricted_inTime takes f : F). UnrestrictedEventually is ∀ p g, ∃ T, ∀ t ≥ T, a threshold per standpoint and per formation. It is equivalent to MutuallyDependentInTime := ∀ t f g, ∃ u, WithinTime (t,f) (u,g). StepInTime is a formation going on to its next step, or AffectsBefore (an exchange, at an earlier step, with a condition another formation requires later). The one page's short form and ONE-PAGE.zh's (K3's Chinese, character for character) are exact. The overview §7's full form is K3's text, and its Chinese matches. 'Over what comes after' is not joined to the from-some-step-on sentence anywhere on the four pages. It stays only in the one-center clause («续无外于后»'s case, TwoSources.apart). One table-row weakening is fixed; see the next item.

That states only the sufficient direction of an iff the Lean proves (unrestrictedEventually_iff_mutuallyDependentInTime). It is now 'holds exactly where', as K3's short form and the one page say it. Direction.lean's module note says 'The schema and the pool law use neither the continuation condition nor a valuation', and narrowed_not_chosen and widening_not_not_better take Priority (J1/J2) and W.Widens. 07 §7's lead and Conditional label say the same. The Chinese is astra's sentence, natural, with 诸动作 for moves.

THE-THEORY:144 now reads 'On a fixed listing, self-concern and being increasing in admission coincide for every order exactly when every listed item is marked as one's own'. That is (∀ O, IncreasingInOwn ↔ Increasing) ↔ ∀ x ∈ items, own x = true, as PremiseWitnesses.lean:318 states it. The Chinese at .zh:148 was already right. It keeps 重合 rather than 相合, because §6 of the same page uses 相合 as one of chapter 6's verdicts. That reason checks out.

items.item: The one-center clause (critic 5.2 item 11) and critic 5.3 item 21 in the overview's rows
items.how: Row 61's 'on a net going forward in time because nothing other than the center may lie at or before the center's step' is «续无外当且仅当后与独» (its second conjunct) with «独则同一中心». Its Chinese, 在随时间前进的网上，这是因为除中心之外，没有什么可以位于中心那一步或其前, is right. Row 62's 'where the condition, read across all steps, holds de se' is exact, and removes the doubt the critic raised.

Counted on both Chinese pages. 谱系, 一道筛选, 容纳已判定, 已判定, 范围之内者, 只证明了这一个方向 and 每一个延续都可以 each appear 0 times. 这一论证路线 stands next to 两条水平路径, and the remaining 这条路径 are the overview's reading path (15) and the crux path (158). The remaining 它就 (ONE-PAGE.zh 32; THE-THEORY.zh 65, 95, 147) are not the self-concern definition. 可判定 on THE-THEORY.zh:97 is about 归并 (lumpings), not admission. The persisting sentence is the plain one. 在能判定容纳与否时, 这里把自身的延续读作自身所能到达的一切, 每一个延续都能 and （其逆未证） are in place.

The one page's What it is and the overview's lead state the aim as AGENTS.md's first half (no AJ wording). left.item: The overview's table row: the in-time short form beside the one-center clause (low; coordinator)
left.why: Row 61 (zh 65) says that where the condition holds on a net going forward in time, it holds with one center (nothing other than the center at or before its step). It then says 'read in time, it cannot hold over every step'. Read in time here means with every occurrence a standpoint (datedOwnClosure … id). That makes the two clauses consistent, but the short form does not say it, and a reader may see a tension. If wanted: 'read in time, with every occurrence a standpoint, it cannot hold over every step' (zh 按时间来读、以每一个发生为立场，它不能在每一步都成立). §7's full form already says it. Left as the coordinator's short form.
